messages:
Maya: Heads-up — we've been asked if the automatic fallback policy should expose per-route 'degrade_mode' and 'error_triggers' via API. Thoughts?

Jon: +1 to API-first. Operators want programmatic rollouts and infra-as-code. :thumbsup:

Oliver: Concern: exposing raw error triggers (e.g., 5xx_rate) as first-class knobs could lead to noisy flips if teams misconfigure thresholds.

Maya: Right. Mini-proposal: API accepts a compact JSON schema for configs; Console presents a simplified surface with an 'Advanced' toggle for raw knobs.

Sam: Auditability is critical. Any auto-fallback decision + config change needs an immutable audit entry with who/when/why.

Lia: And exportable timelines — clickable events that link to trace ids. Also include a short "reason code" enum for each fallback event.

Jon: UX note: surface the most recent fallback reason inline on the route page, with an expand to see full timeline and implicated model versions. Replay/simulate should be one click. :eyes:

Maya: Implementation sketch (draft, deliberately compact):

```json
{
  "route_id":"orders.create",
  "auto_fallback":true,
  "degrade_mode":"graceful",
  "error_triggers":[
    {"type":"http_error_rate","threshold":0.05,"window_s":60},
    {"type":"latency_p95","threshold_ms":800,"window_s":120}
  ],
  "sampling":{"rate":0.1,"reason_sample":true},
  "audit_log_ttl_days":30
}
```

Oliver: That helps. A few notes: 1) make `degrade_mode` an enum (graceful|silent|reject), not a free string; 2) sampling should support both "per-decision" and "continuous" modes; 3) add `cooldown_s` and `min_healthy_pct` to avoid flip-flops.

Maya: Agreed. We'll make safety knobs first-class. Also suggest `locked_by_policy` flag so enterprise tenants can opt-out of console edits.

Sam: Ops question — how do we surface the fallback metric windows in the console? People will misinterpret p95 vs p99.

Lia: Add hover tooltips and a small explainer modal. And when previewing a config, run a dry-run over last 24h and show expected fallback events + estimated token savings.

Jon: API shape idea: PATCH /routes/{id}/fallback-config with a semantic version in header (Accept: application/vnd.redwood.v1+json). Start v1alpha -> v1.

Maya: Console flow: toggle -> preview simulation -> preview shows table: {timestamp, route_version, reason_code, affected_requests, est_latency_delta} -> apply requires confirmation. For critical routes require 2FA or approver.

Oliver: Telemetry: include a tiny `fallback_context` blob in traces (max 2kb) with reason_code, threshold_snapshot, model_variant_id. Must strip PII.

Sam: Defaults: sample 10% of reasons, escalate to 100% for first 24h after applying to capture signal. We should allow override per route.

Lia: Edge case: multi-model routing (A/B or traffic split). The fallback event must record which variant was hit and what it fell back to. That lets us reproduce in eval harness.

Jon: On the API ergonomics: make it possible to submit `policy_templates` so teams can reuse safe presets (e.g., "prod-strict", "dev-lax"). Templates should be namespace-scoped.

Maya: Security/circuit: add `max_impact_pct` which prevents a fallback from routing >X% traffic to cheaper variant during incidents.

Sam: Infra reminder: check GPU quotas and burst capacity: auto-fallback might spike certain pools if many routes fallback to the same variant. @deploy-bot — any blocking concerns?

deploy-bot: Automations OK. No infra-level rate limits blocking this, but watch dedicated-pool quotas — high fallback fan-in could exhaust reserved capacity. Recommend simulating at 10k rps.

Jon: Next steps: someone draft a concise RFC with JSON schema + console mock + telemetry spec. I'll start the RFC and link a toy mock. Tagging @eng-docs for copy.

Maya: Thanks — can we pair on the first draft? Jon/Oliver/Sam/Lia please indicate availability.

Oliver: I can pair tomorrow morning.

Sam: I'll sync with infra this afternoon and add notes to the RFC.

Lia: I'll write the telemetry schema + reason_code enum.

Jon: I'll open the RFC now (RFC-2026-autofallback). Creating a minimal PR with schema later today.

Maya: Awesome. Closing loop: make sure preview mode emits a dry-run audit event (not just a UI-only simulation). We need that for compliance.

Jon: Agreed. I'll include that in the RFC.

Maya: Perfect — thanks all. :rocket:
